extraFields.label: Society maintenance
extraFields.help: The monthly maintenance charge your housing society or apartment association collects (security, lifts, common areas, water pumps). Leave at 0 if it is already included in your rent.

single.note: Estimate: typical metro society charges ~₹2–5 per sq ft a month; often included in rent for single renters.

suburban.note: Estimate for a 2–3 BHK (900–1,500 sq ft) at ~₹2–5 per sq ft a month.

youngpro.note: Estimate for a 1–2 BHK in a gated society.

extraFields.label: Power backup (inverter or DG charges)
extraFields.help: Diesel generator backup charged by your society, or inverter battery and UPS upkeep, as a monthly amount. Skip it if you have no backup.

single.note: Society DG (diesel generator) backup charges or inverter battery upkeep; varies widely by city and society. Estimate.

suburban.note: Society DG (diesel generator) backup charges or inverter battery upkeep; varies widely by city and society. Estimate.

youngpro.note: Society DG (diesel generator) backup charges or inverter battery upkeep; varies widely by city and society. Estimate.

extraFields.label: Chit fund / kitty payment
extraFields.help: Your monthly contribution to a chit fund, kitty or other rotating savings group. Each member pays in every month and takes the whole pot once. It works like saving, so it can be paused if money is tight, but count it here so you know where the money goes.

single.note: Estimate; no published average for household chit/kitty contributions.

suburban.note: Estimate; no published average for household chit/kitty contributions.

youngpro.note: Estimate; no published average for household chit/kitty contributions.

localTips.title: Check the rooftop solar subsidy
localTips.why: If you own your home and the AC runs most of the year, a small rooftop system can wipe out most of a bill that sits in the higher slabs.
tips: Look up PM Surya Ghar on the official portal: it pays a central subsidy for home rooftop solar up to 3 kW.
Ask your DISCOM for a net meter so units you export are taken off your bill.
Get 2–3 quotes from vendors on the DISCOM’s approved list before you pay anything.

pct.note: Rough share of the electricity bill a 2–3 kW system offsets; depends on roof, state tariff and usage.

localTips.title: Book LPG refills only when needed and claim any subsidy
localTips.why: Cooking gas is most of the “water and gas” line in Indian homes.
tips: Link your LPG connection to Aadhaar and your bank so any subsidy reaches your account.
Use a pressure cooker and lids on pans: they cut cooking gas noticeably.
If your building has piped gas (PNG), compare its cost per month with cylinder refills.

localTips.title: Use a metro smart card or monthly pass
localTips.why: Metro smart cards and monthly bus passes are cheaper per trip than paying cash or taking autos and cabs every day.
tips: Use a metro smart card or NCMC card instead of single tokens; many metros give a discount per trip.
Check if your city bus service sells a monthly pass.
Share cabs with colleagues for the last mile instead of solo rides.
